title: Direct experimental test of Feynman's path integral postulates with single photons

files_used.Fig4A.csv: path length versus reported path probability amplitude
files_used.Fig4B.csv: classical action versus reported path probability amplitude
files_used.Fig4C.csv: classical action versus measured and theoretical phase
files_used.FigS2B.xlsx: independent aggregate radial phase control: 17 experimental points and 200-point theory curve
files_used.FigS2C.xlsx: published normalized-amplitude histograms for 17 radial propagator classes
files_used.FigS2D.xlsx: published normalized-amplitude means and standard deviations for 17 radial propagator classes
files_used.raw_propagator/FigS1C.xlsx: published sample propagator used as an independent reconstruction check

claim_boundary: The aggregate tables test the standard action-phase and equal-amplitude controls. The raw matrices permit a diagnostic reconstruction of the shared radial step kernel and 17^5 algebraic paths. The paths are not independent measurements, the raw-image amplitude reduction fails the FigS1C validation, and the standard optical action is not an independent Tau morphological-body action.
